summary.text: Mike Beltz is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 20 (home city listed as Hillsboro), serving since 2021 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Beltz lists an occupation of Farmer.
It lists education as BS, Animal Science, NDSU.
It also lists Caledonia Township Assessor, Supervisor, ND Dry Bean Council, US Dry Bean Council, Ag Issues & Govt. Affairs Comm., ND Soybean Council and Chairman, ND Ag Coalition.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Beltz's standing committee assignments as Agriculture (chairman) and Human Services.
